scope: The 2 admitted X509_VERIFY_POLICY production obligation(s) in src/x509/v3_addr.rs that the enumerated SSH closure reports as reachable but without an owning boundary receipt are enumerated here for ownership only, at their census coordinates, with a hazard read from each function. This receipt claims no discharge, no contract and no new reachability finding.
non_claims: This receipt does not discharge any site, and no site may be treated as discharged on its authority.
This receipt does not contract any site; the hazard notes are enumeration notes, not established contracts.
This receipt does not assert reachability; reachability is taken from the enumerated closure and is not re-established here.

boundaries.hazard: Raw STACK_OF(IPAddressFamily) is iterated; each addressFamily octet string is read at index 2 after only a length > 2 test, and BIO writes are unchecked.
Raw STACK_OF(CONF_VALUE) is parsed into a new stack with a comparator; name/value pointers are dereferenced under the stack contract, and NULL is returned on allocation or parse failure.
